tasks.acceptance_criteria: Authentication, password hash policy, sessions/tokens, membership & role guard; unauthorized denied
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Internal email/password using standard secure hashes, secure HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite sessions and CSRF for state changes; membership-scoped owner/admin/accountant/viewer; no super-admin or default credentials.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Create/list/select company only via membership; scoped identifiers unique
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Company membership enforced server-side; cross-tenant IDOR API negative tests, no user-provided tenant identity trusted.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Fiscal year + periods cannot overlap within company; open/close rules and year boundary
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Company-specific non-overlapping fiscal periods with exclusive end; DATE Gregorian and Asia/Tehran cutoff, UTC events; transactionally guard closed period vs posting race.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Decimal normalization, currency and range rules; floats rejected
tasks.mandatory_amendments: IRR only, nonnegative integer rial via Decimal; PostgreSQL NUMERIC(20,0), decimal string API, reject float, overprecision and out-of-range values.
tasks.evidence_required: Precision, overflow and invalid amount cases

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Group/کل/معین/تفصیلی hierarchy; scoped codes unique; no posting to non-leaves; used accounts not deletable
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Hierarchical detail subordinate to subsidiary, not floating detail; unique fully qualified company codes, only postable detail leaves or subsidiary without detail; protect used accounts.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Append-only actor/time/company/action audit trail; no secret leakage
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Persist sensitive event actor/company/time and safe changes, immutable through UI; redact credentials and prevent cross-company audit leakage.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Draft journal CRUD; valid lines, account/company/period checked; drafts never appear in ledgers
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Drafts may save incomplete and unbalanced with visible validation warnings; validate safe company/account scope; excluded from posted financial aggregates. Strict balance only at H-12 posting.
tasks.evidence_required: Draft, invalid lines and cross-tenant tests

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Server-side exact balance, atomic posting, no overwrite of posted lines, role/period/number guards
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Posting only: at least 2 valid rows, positive debit=credit, exact Decimal; immutable posted lines, atomic transaction, authorization and open-period checks, unique never-reused fiscal voucher sequence with traceable gaps.
tasks.evidence_required: Atomic rollback, imbalance and state tests

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Linked full reversal, no modifying original, prevention of duplicate reversals unless explicitly defined
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Reverse only via a new linked immutable balanced posted voucher, original unchanged; reversed label derived; prohibit duplicate reversal without defined policy. F2 mandatory.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Double-submit idempotency; concurrent post vs close protected; conflict responses deterministic
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Real PostgreSQL tests for simultaneous posting, retry idempotency, number uniqueness, posting vs fiscal close and deterministic conflicts; release-blocking.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Posted-only journal/daybook and 3 ledger levels; ordered movements, opening/closing/running balance, period filters
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Posted-only daybook/general/subsidiary/detail account ledgers with running balance, opening and closing, pagination and filters, F1/F2 reconciliation.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Trial balance by company/year/date; debit/credit sums reconcile to journal; no draft impact
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Actual posted journal-derived trial balance by tenant/fiscal/date, no draft effect; F1/F2 sums and F3 isolation mandatory; no V1.0 CSV export.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Persian RTL tokens, light/dark, typography, numeric fields, accessibility and 360px responsive rules
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Design-only ownership; accessible Persian RTL, Jalali, IRR and responsive 360px light/dark specs. Do not modify frontend implementation.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Login, company and period selector journeys; error/empty/loading/permission states
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Design-only, state maps for internal email/password auth, company membership and fiscal selection, permission and expired session.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Chart editor + multi-line voucher UX; balancing feedback, confirmations and posted read-only states
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Design-only journal flows must allow incomplete/unbalanced drafts with explicit warning, but block post until valid; immutable posted and reversal states.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Ledger/trial balance table, large-data paging, Persian/Jalali, printable view as optional browser print
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Design-only ledger and trial balance flows; browser print optional, not V1.0 PDF/CSV export.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Frontend shell, routing, RTL/theme/accessible primitives, typed contract; no business mock shown as real

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Auth and tenant/period flows integrated; expired access handled safely
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Secure live tenant/period auth integration, membership guard, 401/403 and CSRF-related error flows, no mock activity shown as real.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Account hierarchy CRUD, validation and duplicate errors integrated
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Only feature accounts paths, integrate validated account hierarchy, postable leaves and isolated companies.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Draft/edit/post/reverse; line totals display; posted immutability; double click doesn't double-post
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Live draft/save warning, post, reverse, immutable posted, concurrent click protection; F1/F2 browser scenario mandatory.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Journal/ledger/trial balance usable on desktop/mobile, filters and exact decimal formatting
tasks.mandatory_amendments: Actual posted-only ledgers/trial balance UI, Jalali and exact IRR formatting; no V1.0 CSV or PDF generation.
